evidence.notes: The re-premise keeps the card's central discipline intact: RE-PREMISE, never relax. The positional-zip defect was an instance of the card pinning a PROBE MECHANIC rather than the card's INTENT; the opcode decomposition pins the intent (the health URL constant moves and nothing else moves) in a form that is mechanically satisfiable by exactly one diff shape. The lesson (t91 merge-window class) is recorded in the platform comment: a probe must be run against its own true positive before shipping - the groom run could not GREEN ac2 (the edit was uncommitted by design), so the defect stayed latent until the builder's commit became the first-ever true positive.
